title: Set up your shop
description: Follow these steps to get your shop ready. You can pause at any time and return to your progress later.
resumeNote: Your progress is saved on this device. You can come back and continue later.
completeDescription: You can return to settings at any time to make changes.
vaultNote: Shop creation provides a main vault. Check that your branch uses the right default vault.

shop.title: Shop details and logo
shop.description: Add your shop name, contact details, address, language, timezone, and logo.

tax.title: Tax registration
tax.description: Enter the seller's legal name, commercial registration, and tax registration number.

branches.title: Branches
branches.description: Add the locations where your team will work and confirm their contact details.

vaults.title: Cash vaults
vaults.description: Check the main vault created for your shop and the default vault assigned to each branch.

receipt.title: Receipt settings
receipt.description: Choose the receipt header, footer, paper width, and the details printed for customers.

installments.title: Installment policy
installments.description: Set the terms your shop will use for installment sales, if this feature is part of your plan.

employees.title: First employees
employees.description: Invite your team and assign each person a role and branch access.
